header_data_contracts.notes: Identity, geometry revision, support clocks, pending ownership, source ledger and motion/frontier summaries all have consumers. EmptySince state removed after common absorption authorization replaced its only consumer.
128-bit scope plus generation is identity. input_through orders requests and is never geometric support.
Owner mutex is required; reserved one-node output list makes completion allocation-free. Failure state is sticky; ready output cannot escape after failure.

findings.counterexample: current support 5, pending support 8, accepted motion 10 previously closed both but retained floor 5; a delayed support-7 fragment could then become current despite a support-8 closed predecessor.

Old current supported at 1 and a geometrically overlapping segment observed only in [3,4], with no intervening current support, previously merged solely because EmptySince was false. No actual time supplied authorization A.
findings.change: One canAbsorb implements interval membership and canRefine. Ingestion checks direct and confirmed support separately, otherwise preserves pending; the real support reducer uses the same helper. The old EmptySince shortcut and now-unused state/persistence fields are removed.
findings.two_clock_case: direct=8, confirmed=12, candidate=[7,9] remains authorized by direct=8; using max(direct,confirmed) alone would wrongly suppress it.

findings.kind: Explicit native-presence compatibility operator needed in README; no ordinary-input contradiction established.
findings.exact_operator: Sort sources by (inputFirst,inputLast,node). Select r by max(inputLast,inputFirst,node), R=last native right endpoint of r. For each non-r [a,d], cap d by R and next inputFirst if positive. Keep a<=d, union overlapping/touching intervals, discard terminal starts>R and set last right endpoint to R. Source r owns raw geometry (including intentionally empty dynamic mesh); registry materializes its own current geometry afterward.
findings.resolution: README (5f) now defines interval-record coalescing, retained degenerate endpoint anchors, latest right ownership and final half-open interpretation. Verified [1,2), newest [4,4), R=4 stays [1,2), rather than extending old presence through the gap.

nonblocking_observations: canonicalizePhysicalObjects constructs an unused local registry when registry=null; this does not duplicate inference. Its behavior uses newest raw segment without state write-back. Optional cleanup only.

sessionCopyElsewhere uses the exact reliable point collection, validates denominator size, and compares total-shared versus shared under stated mobility/time eligibility. Partial-view or noisy-world quality limits are model applicability, not an algebraic denominator mismatch.
